result.title: Transferable, Time-Parallel Graph Dynamics via Space-Time Factorization
result.summary: Time-parallel neural operators (FNO and successors) have transformed PDE surrogates on regular grids. Mesh-based operators (MeshGraphNets, Transolver) extend operator learning to irregular geometries, but jointly learning across diverse topologies while retaining non-recurrent temporal evaluation remains challenging. We propose space-time factorization: partition the model into local temporal operators (learned, graph-independent) and a spatial mixer that propagates information across nodes without graph-dependent learned parameters. This structural condition lets the same parameters run on unseen graphs; non-recurrent instances also admit time-parallel evaluation. Accurate zero-shot transfer further depends on controlling three information leaks (graph-dependent weights, graph-specific features, and graph-correlated training distributions) and on suitable task physics and training coverage. The protocol applies to two distinct spatial-mixer families, fixed-spectral and learned-attention. We validate the principle in three domains. For floodwave propagation in river networks, a 27K-parameter model trained on the Yangtze transfers zero-shot to the Mississippi with median NSE 0.998 in boundary-conditioned operational evaluation, training 5.5x faster than a stabilized recurrent baseline. On cross-geometry Navier-Stokes, the three-seed SepFNO mean relative vorticity error on five unseen targets falls by about 28% from 5 to 12 training geometries, with a consistent single-run SepTransolver trend. On cross-city traffic forecasting, zero-shot transfer reaches within 12.9% of an oracle trained on the target city. Across settings, cross-geometry error decreases with both the number of training geometries and their relatedness to the test, at a rate depending on the spatial mixer. This opens the path to pooled-data, foundation-style models for graph dynamics on irregular topologies.

AI.brief_summary: 提出「时空分解」：将图动力学模型拆为与图结构无关的局部时间算子加不含图相关可学习参数的空间混合器，使同一组参数可零样本迁移到未见拓扑并支持非循环的时间并行评估，在河网洪水、跨几何 Navier–Stokes 与跨城市交通上验证，并分析三类信息泄漏对迁移的影响。
AI.relevance_reason: 把状态更新与结构相关的信息混合解耦，并显式控制图相关权重、图特异特征、图相关训练分布这三类泄漏，可供核查 latent 推理中「视觉/结构旁路」如何影响内部状态内容的因果使用及其评测协议；其非循环并行评估也可能提示并行 latent 生成的成本权衡，但迁移需较多核查。
